content: Berocca is a tablet that contains a specific combination of B-group vitamins and Vitamin C. It is available in various countries, including Argentina, Australia, Austria, Finland, France, Ireland, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Portugal, Russia, Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, and the United Kingdom. Originally manufactured by Roche Pharmaceuticals, Berocca is now produced by Bayer following Bayer's global acquisition of Roche Consumer Health in January 2005. Berocca is available in different varieties. The Berocca Original and Berocca Tropical formulations are sold in packs of 10, 15, and 30 effervescent tablets. Berocca Performance is available in packs of 15 and 30 effervescent tablets, as well as in packs of 30 regular film-coated tablets. The Berocca Performance formulation is an enhanced version that includes B-group vitamins, Vitamin C, and additional minerals such as magnesium, calcium, and zinc. The ingredients in Berocca Original include citric acid, sodium hydrogen carbonate, Vitamin C, magnesium sulfate, mannitol, calcium carbonate, magnesium carbonate, flavoring agents, coloring agents (beetroot red, beta carotene), sodium carbonate, niacin, sweeteners (aspartame, acesulfame K), sodium chloride, zinc citrate, pantothenic acid, riboflavin, thiamin, Vitamin B12, Vitamin B6, an anti-foaming agent (polysorbate 60), folacin (folic acid), and biotin. It contains a source of phenylalanine. The active ingredients in Berocca Original and Tropical include: Thiamine hydrochloride (Vitamin B1): 15 mg Riboflavin (Vitamin B2): 15 mg Nicotinamide (Vitamin B3): 50 mg Pantothenic acid (Vitamin B5): 23 mg Pyridoxine hydrochloride (Vitamin B6): 10 mg Cyanocobalamin (Vitamin B12): 10 mcg Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C): 1000 mg Calcium: 65 mg The active ingredients in Berocca Performance include: Thiamine hydrochloride (Vitamin B1): 15 mg Riboflavin (Vitamin B2): 15 mg Nicotinamide (Vitamin B3): 50 mg Pantothenic acid (Vitamin B5): 23 mg Pyridoxine hydrochloride (Vitamin B6): 10 mg Cyanocobalamin (Vitamin B12): 10 mcg Biotin (Vitamin H): 150 mcg Folic acid: 400 mcg Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C): 500 mg Calcium: 100 mg Magnesium: 100 mg Zinc: 10 mg Berocca is anecdotally reported to prevent or relieve hangovers when taken before or after alcohol consumption. When consumed in effervescent form, it provides a rehydrating effect. There is some evidence suggesting that B vitamins may help alleviate hangover symptoms. Additionally, its sweet and fizzy solution is often gentler on the stomach compared to other vitamin supplements in tablet form. All Berocca products are gluten-free and lactose-free. The recommended daily dose for individuals aged 11 and above is one tablet per day. Each Berocca tablet contains 285 mg of sodium, which should be considered by individuals on a low-sodium diet. Users are advised to always read the label, use the product as directed, and consult a doctor if symptoms persist. Berocca has been widely advertised, particularly in Australia, where it gained recognition through television commercials in the 1980s and 1990s with the slogan Berocca gives you back your B-B-Bounce. Current marketing campaigns in Australia for Berocca Performance use the slogan Release the inner geek, targeting students preparing for final exams. In South Africa, a campaign with the slogan Be ready, Be sharp, Be somebody, Berocca was launched. In the UK, long-running outdoor poster campaigns have used the slogan Stay sharp.
